shots.say: It is photo day at the zoo! But the sun is so, so hot.
I'm Milo! Can you help Tumble stay cool today?
This is Tumble, the baby elephant. And this is my camera!
We take our photo when the sun is low, Tumble.
I want to look my very best. All clean and shiny!
But it is a hot, hot day. How will you stay cool, Tumble?
shots.tag: Milo: how will you stay cool

shots.say: I will find a way. And I will not get dirty!
Have fun, Tumble. And stay out of the hot sun!
Off they go, to find a cool place.
Friends help friends, come along with me! Step by step, what will we see?
The sun shines down on the wide savanna.
Oh my! My head is so hot.
Hmm. What could keep the sun off Tumble's head? A hat, or a shoe?
In the green jungle, the leaves are big and round.
A leaf! I can make a sun hat.
Tumble puts the big leaf on his head. A leaf hat!
Oh, that is better. Now my head is cool!
But look. The leaf is small. Tumble's big back is still in the sun.
shots.tag: the back is in the sun

shots.say: Is one leaf big enough for a whole elephant? Yes, or no?
No. My back is hot, hot, hot.
Hello down there! You look hot, Tumble.
It is Mango, the spider monkey! And Mango has an idea.
I will fan you with a palm leaf. Flap, flap, flap!
Ooh, a little wind! That feels nice.
Oh dear. My arms are tired!
The fan stops. And Tumble is hot again.
Wait! Tumble, you have two fans of your own. Your ears!
My ears? Flap, flap, flap!
An elephant flaps its big ears to cool its body on warm days.
Can you flap your arms like big ears? Flap, flap, flap!
That helps a little. But the sun is still so hot.
Then Mango points. Look! Shade, under the tallest tree.
Tumble steps into the shade. Oh, so cool!
This is the best spot. I will stay right here.
But the sun moves across the sky. And the shade moves, too.
Step. Step. Step. Tumble follows the shade.
Now the sun is right over the tree. And the shade is tiny!
Only my toes fit in the shade!
Hot and tired, Tumble walks on.
And there it is. A big, brown, muddy puddle.
Oh no. Mud! I must stay clean for the photo.
I tried a hat. I tried a fan. I tried the shade.
And I am still so hot.
Tumble stops by the puddle. He feels hot and grumpy. His friends come close.
Tumble is hot and grumpy. What could help him cool down?
It is okay, Tumble. We will think of something together.
Splash! What is that sound?
Mama! You are all muddy!
Of course, little one. Mud keeps an elephant cool.
And mud keeps the hot sun off our skin.
Elephants roll in mud. The mud protects their skin from the sun.
shots.tag: fact: mud protects from the sun

shots.say: So mud is like a sun hat, for an elephant's whole body!
But, Mama. What about my photo?
A happy elephant makes the very best photo.
Then, one toe. One foot. And...
Splash! Tumble jumps into the mud!
Oh! It is so cool. And so squishy!
That is my muddy little elephant!
He rolls to the left. He rolls to the right.
Can you roll your arms like Tumble? Roll, roll, roll!
That looks like fun! Plop. A drop of mud lands on Mango's nose.
Now everyone is cool. And everyone is laughing.
Back at the zoo, the sun is low. It is photo time!
I am not clean, Milo. But I am cool, and I am happy!
Then that is the photo I want! Everybody, say mud!
Three, two, one. Click!
And here is the photo. Muddy, cool, and smiling!
That is the best photo ever!
Mama wraps her trunk around Tumble. A big, muddy trunk hug.
I love mud days, Mama.
Me too, my little Tumble.
It is okay to get a little messy when you play.
Do you remember? What keeps the sun off an elephant's skin? A fan, or mud?
And what does an elephant flap to cool down? Its ears, or its tail?
Friends help friends, hooray, hooray!
What a muddy, happy day!
See you on the next adventure, friends!
